body:
I was keen to try extasy for the sexual enhancement effects because I was jealous that my girlfriend used to do it with her ex and lose her inhibitions and such.  I did it a couple of times with these Versace faced yellow pills. WOW Imagine the best sex you've had and x it by 100. Now comes the bad part. Some weeks later I got a couple of these white pills with safe sex engraved into them.
I had the pill and felt nothing until 25 minutes later (pretty normal). What happens next is terrifying.  My heart starts racing and I begin to have trouble breathing. It felt as though my breathing was no longer and involuntary action but something I had to remember to do. My heart was beating rapid but it was also such that I couldn't feel it all too well and occasionally I would get a pins and needles sensation in it.
On top of this I'm starting to feel faint and my eyes want to close, but I feel like if I close them I dont know what will happen. My body temperature has is rising and falling. I'm hot and cold all at once. My hands are now throbbing too and its getting harder remembering to breath. (note that I am prone to panic also)
Somehow I get through this but am silly enough to repeat this with half a pill 5 days later resulting in the same reaction albeit a little worse than the first time. I am hospitalised and they take my bloods and give saline and top up my electrolytes.
Anyway that my experience
. I dont know if it was
A) an allergic reaction
B) hypersensitivity
C) overdose
D) bad pill
E) pill containing PCP
Now I find myself much more sensitive to caffeine and I experienced two major panic attacks 2 weeks after the hospitalisation just by thinking about the experience.
